service.name: Crafter & Gatherer Leveling Boost
service.longDescription: Crafters and gatherers level on their own track — leves, collectables and cosmic missions included. Our Crafter & Gatherer Leveling boost takes any Disciple of the Hand or Land to your target level while you keep every scrip, material and reward.

rewards.title: Level Up!
rewards.text: Any Disciple of the Hand or Land leveled to your chosen level.

rewards.title: Crafting & Gathering Unlocked
rewards.text: Higher-tier recipes, gathering nodes and job actions at your target level.

rewards.title: Scrips & Materials Kept
rewards.text: Every scrip, collectable and material earned along the way stays on your character.

rewards.title: Time Saver
rewards.text: Skip the leve and collectable grind — straight to endgame crafting and gathering.
